image_description: A low-angle shot of a large pipe organ installed in an architectural alcove or balcony. The organ features three distinct vertical sections (towers) of wooden pipes with varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The pipes are housed in dark, ornate wooden casings. Below the pipes is a white balustrade railing. The background consists of cream-colored arched ceilings with decorative molding. No console, keyboards, or pedalboard are visible in this frame.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other architectural structures.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the pipes and ensure they do not melt into the background architecture or ceiling.
To check for boundary bleeding between adjacent pipes and ensure each pipe is a distinct, continuous entity.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the wood grain or plasterwork that might indicate AI generation artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the verticality of the pipes. AI generators often struggle with maintaining perfect parallel lines for long vertical structures like organ pipes. Check for slight warping or 'bowing' of the pipes. Also, verify that the lighting reflections on the wooden pipes are consistent with a single light source from above/front.
